status: catalog-only; these are specifications, not 100 running agents
versioning_policy: Semantic versioning: MAJOR for incompatible contracts or safety changes, MINOR for backward-compatible capability additions, PATCH for bug fixes and prompt/rule corrections.
model_policy: Model identity and model version must be recorded separately from agent and prompt versions. Never claim a model is installed, available, trained, or benchmarked without evidence.
learning_policy: Learn from reviewed task outcomes by adding approved examples, regression tests, and versioned prompt/rule updates. No autonomous self-modifying code or unreviewed model-weight training.
approval_policy: Human approval required for external communication, account changes, submissions, publishing, purchases, deployments, payout settings, destructive actions, and any spend.
budget_policy: No paid APIs or subscriptions by default. Tests must work offline with deterministic mocks.
